Life / another gallery wing

Intelligence is
also embodied.

Dance, sport, travel, and photography are not an appendix to my research. They are different practices of attention: learning through movement, uncertainty, place, and observation.

01Movement02Travel03Photography
01Movement

Practice, balance,
and expressive control.

Dance and sport taught me that precision is not rigidity. It is the ability to remain responsive while acting with intention.

Dance

Learning through form,
rhythm, and attention.

A long practice in embodied learning and expressive control—valuable because of the practice itself, not only the credential.

Royal Academy of Dance · A2 Distinction
Sport

Acting under
changing conditions.

Sailing, skateboarding, and athletics each make feedback immediate: balance, adapt, commit, correct.

National First-Class Athlete · DKU Athletic Champion 2022 & 2023
02Travel

Moving through
unfamiliar worlds.

Travel is a practice of looking again: at scale, culture, landscape, and the assumptions I carry into a place.

COLLECTION / FORTHCOMING

Visual stories will appear here as they are selected—organized by place and trip, without stock imagery standing in for lived experience.

How to add photographs +
